# Short a Rider

*Edric's road patrol is a rider short. Ride out with Aylwin to Downs Edge, where the downs meet the World Tree Road, and clear 20 wild bees off the road verge. Then report to Aylwin.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 20 [Wild Bee](../monsters/wild_bee.md) in [Downs Edge](../maps/downs_edge.md)
2. Talk to [Aylwin](../npcs/aylwin.md)

## Rewards

- 2,800 EXP
- 400 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +30 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Edric](../npcs/edric.md)
